svg.title: How I work
svg.desc: I don’t ship what I don’t understand. I design the architecture, get my hands dirty in the code, and take systems apart until I know exactly why they work, down to the data model and how they behave when something fails. AI speeds up the routine work. The parts that need real care, I write myself. Every call is mine, and nothing goes out until it meets my standard and passes the tests I wrote.
